subject: Arcadia Retail - post-demo recap & Q4 timing check
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@arcadia-retail.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@arcadia-retail.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Oct 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Arcadia Retail - post-demo recap & Q4 timing check

Hi Maya / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the candid operational details you shared about checkout latency and seasonal traffic patterns. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Demo highlights: real-time routing can reduce peak latency by ~30% and the KV prefix caching we showed keeps cold-starts below 120ms for the most frequent flows.
- Business outcomes you called out: reduce cart drop at >50ms slowdowns during promotions; predictable per-checkout cost for CFO/finance.
- Proposed immediate scope: small pilot on checkout + homepage personalization (2 GPU nodes, ~4 week pilot).

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) I’ll send a one-page proposal + SOW for review (attached: RDW_Proposal_Arcadia_v3.pdf).
2) Your team to confirm decision owner(s) + target procurement timeline for Q4.
3) Optional: 30-min follow-up with engineering to lock integration details (Jordan can run).

Ask: can you confirm whether procurement is still on track to review for a November start? If your priority/timing shifted for Q4, please let us know so we can adjust the proposal and resourcing.

Attached is the proposal and a draft SOW for the pilot (SOW_Arcadia_Initial.docx).

Thanks —

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments (stubs): RDW_Proposal_Arcadia_v3.pdf (pdf, 2 pages), SOW_Arcadia_Initial.docx (docx, 3 pages)

Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arcadia Retail - post-demo recap & Q4 timing check

Hi Maya —

Just bumping this in case it got buried ahead of the long weekend. We want to make sure our plan lines up with Arcadia’s internal gates for a November kickoff. If you’ve already handed the docs to procurement, a quick note on timeline is perfect.

If priorities shifted, no problem — tell us where the timeline landed and we’ll adapt.

—Stephanie

Hi Stephanie —

Apologies for the delay — we had an internal reprioritization. Short version: the exec team pushed certain platform work to the back half of Q4 to focus on a security roll; that impacts our November window.

That said, we still want to run a pilot — just shifting the start to mid-December. Two asks from our side: 
- Can you update the SOW to reflect a Dec 15 start and a 6-week pilot (instead of 4)?
- Can you provide a short note on estimated spend vs. usage cap we should include for procurement (high-level ranges are fine)?

If you can get the revised SOW and a one-page cost summary by EOD Monday we’ll circulate to procurement and finance.

Thanks —
Maya Patel
Head of Digital Ops | Arcadia Retail
maya.patel@arcadia-retail.com | +1 (212) 555-0147
